resources.string: Your AI recognition and privacy-first nutrition tracker. No registration needed. We do not store your personal health data on external servers. Your first 90 AI pictures are free.
Restoring your settings and any unfinished meal on this device.
Snackshot couldn\'t start its on-device database. Nothing was deleted or sent anywhere. Try again, or restart the app.
Your data stays on your phone
Here is where your information is kept, what leaves your phone for food recognition, and what changes if you connect Google Health Connect.
Snackshot needs no registration and keeps no health data on its servers. Your meals, calories and macros are saved in the app\'s database on this phone and keep working offline.
Customer profiles, nutrition logs, personal health data and photos

To count your 90 free AI pictures and manage AI access, a small Snackshot service keeps an anonymous ID, a scrambled device identifier, the number of pictures used and your AI access status. Nothing that identifies you, and no photos or meals.
Calorie and macro goals stay on this phone only.

To recognize a meal, Snackshot sends only the picture you selected to LogMeal, the recognition service, together with your language and country so that food names and regional dishes are recognized correctly. It is not linked with your personal information.
The one photo you took or picked from your gallery, and your language and country
Your name, account, goals, meal history or other photos
The processed meal picture is kept with your meal for up to 365 days. The original capture is deleted after processing.
To make Snackshot better, the app sends one anonymous summary per day, for example how long AI recognition took and how often features were used.
Counts and timings only. No personal data, no identifiers, no food names, photos or nutrition values.
Switch product metrics off at any time in Settings
Health Connect is optional. Snackshot works fully without it, and your meals stay only on this phone.
To use it, sign in to the Google Health app with an existing Google account or create a new one, and link Snackshot there
New meals are saved to Health Connect too, which keeps your history and can share it with compatible apps you allow, for recommendations or other services
Connect or disconnect later in Settings
